prompt: The help desk applies a six-minute response limit to tickets received on or after July 1, and a ten-minute limit to earlier tickets. An automatic acknowledgment stops neither clock; the first reply signed by a staff member stops it even if that reply asks for more information. A ticket received on June 30 at 8:00 got an automatic message at 8:04 and a signed question at 8:08, so the report should _____.
promptZh: 服務台對 7 月 1 日起收到的案件採六分鐘回覆時限，較早收到的案件採十分鐘時限。自動確認訊息不能停止計時；第一封有員工署名的回覆即停止計時，即使內容只是要求補充資料。某案在 6 月 30 日 8:00 收到，8:04 發出自動訊息，8:08 發出署名詢問，因此報表應_____。

options.text: record an on-time four-minute reply under the old limit
options.zh: 依舊時限登記四分鐘、準時回覆
options.whyZh: 舊時限正確，但 8:04 的自動訊息不停止計時。

options.text: record a late eight-minute reply under the new limit
options.zh: 依新時限登記八分鐘、逾時回覆
options.whyZh: 8:08 的人工回覆時間算對，但案件適用舊限。

options.text: leave the clock running because the signed reply did not resolve the issue
options.zh: 署名信未解決問題，應繼續計時
options.whyZh: 停止計時取決於首封人工署名回覆，非是否解決或結案。

options.text: record an on-time eight-minute reply under the old limit
options.zh: 依舊時限登記八分鐘、準時回覆
options.whyZh: 舊案適用十分鐘；8:08 有員工署名回覆，八分鐘未超時。

explanationZh: 舊案適用十分鐘；8:08 有員工署名回覆，八分鐘未超時。
evidence: a ten-minute limit to earlier tickets / An automatic acknowledgment stops neither clock / the first reply signed by a staff member stops it / a signed question at 8:08 / received on June 30 at 8:00

vocabulary.note: 客服系統可自動發送此類訊息，告知使用者案件已送達。
